option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: $sdk="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk"; & "$sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe" start-server; if (-not (& "$sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe" devices | Select-String "emulator-\d+\s+device")) { Start-Process "$sdk\emulator\emulator.exe" -ArgumentList "-avd Pixel -no-snapshot-load -gpu swiftshader_indirect" }; & "$sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe" wait-for-device; do { Start-Sleep 3 } until ((& "$sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe" shell getprop sys.boot_completed) -match "1"); & "$sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe" reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081; npx expo start --dev-client --android
